defs.def: a long thin piece of strong hard material, especially wood, used, for example, for making floors, building walls and roofs and making boats 板；（尤指）木板

ex.s: My partner posted her request on the notice board of a local park.
ex.t: 我的搭档把她的要求贴在当地一个公园的布告栏上。

ex.s: Imagine a child standing on a diving board four feet high and asking himself the question:“Should I jump?
ex.t: 想象一个孩子站在四英尺高的跳水板上问自己一个问题："我应该跳下去吗？

ex.s: And while many took dollars, many others pinned their own cash to the board.
ex.t: 虽然许多人拿了钱，但也有许多人把自己的现金别在板上。

ex.s: At the club,1 had my first try at skateboarding and fell off the board a lot.
ex.t: 在俱乐部， 1我第一次尝试滑板，经常从滑板上摔下来。

ex.s: "We even had a bride in her wedding dress come up to the board and take a few dollars." Most of the bills on the board were singles, but a few people left fives, tens and even twenties.
ex.t: “我们甚至有一位穿着婚纱的新娘走到板前拿了几美元。”板上的钞票大多是1美元，但有几个人留下了5美元、10美元甚至20美元。

ex.s: A few minutes later, when I landed the trick, my friends beat their boards loud, shouting: “ Safe!
ex.t: 几分钟后，当我成功完成那个技巧时，朋友们大声拍板，喊着：稳了！

ex.s: You can also find students on the class discussion board to organize a study group, or schedule in-person meetings with your professor to discuss course concepts.
ex.t: 你也可以在课堂讨论板上找同学组建学习小组，或约教授当面讨论课程概念。

ex.s: 36  Like the child on  the  diving  board, you will stay undecided.
ex.t: 36  像跳水板上的孩子一样，你会犹豫不决。

ex.s: But at Union Station in Los Angeles last month, a board went up with dollar bills attached to it with pins and a sign that read, "Give What You Can, Take What You Need."
ex.t: 但上个月在洛杉矶的联合车站，立起了一块板，上面用图钉钉着美元钞票，还有一块牌子写着：“能给多少给多少，需要多少拿多少。”

defs.def: a piece of wood, or other strong material, that is used for a special purpose 尤用于构成复合词

ex.s: He might have failed in his goal to cross Antarctica, but he had ensured that everyone on board the Endurance survived.
ex.t: 他可能没有实现穿越南极洲的目标，但他确保了耐力号上的每个人都能幸存下来。

defs.def: a group of people who have power to make decisions and control a company or other organization （公司或其他机构的）董事会，委员会，理事会
the meals that are provided when you stay in a hotel, guest house, etc; what you pay for the meals （旅馆、招待所等提供的）伙食，膳食；膳食费用
exams that you take when you apply to go to college in the US （美国大学的）入学考试
the stage in a theatre 舞台
the low wooden wall surrounding the area where a game of ice hockey is played （冰球场周围的）界墙
on or in a ship, an aircraft or a train 在船上（或飞机上、火车上）

ex.s: [THE POWER of GOOD “The British Schindler”: the life of Nicholas Winton] It is August 1939, and a group of frightened children are boarding a train at Prague's Wilson Station.
ex.t: 【善良的力量　“英国辛德勒”：尼古拉斯·温顿的生平】1939年8月，一群受惊的孩子正在布拉格的威尔逊车站登上火车。

ex.s: I saw there were two instructors on board and a man lying across the middle.
ex.t: 我看到船上有两名教练，还有一个男人横躺在中间。

ex.s: On board the ship were twenty-seven men and their leader, the Irish explorer Ernest Shackleton.
ex.t: 船上有二十七名男子和他们的领队、爱尔兰探险家欧内斯特·沙克尔顿。

defs.def: giving your support to an idea or a project 支持

ex.s: Be sure to schedule set times to watch your lectures, read materials and contribute to online discussion boards.
ex.t: 不同文化间道德美德的相似性令人瞩目，尽管各种美德的重要性排序可能因社会群体的历史和环境而异。

ex.s: If you have individuals who are not on board, your words probably won’t do much and can often leave you feeling more discouraged.
ex.t: 如果有不支持你的人，你说的话可能起不了多大作用，而且往往让你更加沮丧。

defs.def: to get on a ship, train, plane, bus, etc. 上船（或火车、飞机、公共汽车等）
when a plane or ship is boarding, it is ready for passengers to get on 让乘客登机（或上船等）

ex.s: In March 2008, Ginni boarded a ship with 48 passengers she’d never met before, to begin the journey towards Antarctica.
ex.t: 2008年3月，金妮与48名素未谋面的乘客登上一艘船，开始了前往南极的旅程。

ex.s: Run!” A few times, I have run with passengers to their boarding gate.
ex.t: 跑！有几次，我和乘客一起跑向他们的登机口。

ex.s: All customers travelling on TransLink services must be in possession of a valid ticket before boarding.
ex.t: 所有乘坐TransLink服务的顾客在登机前必须持有有效的车票。

ex.s: Don’t forget to check in online and print your boarding pass in advance.
ex.t: 别忘了在线办理登机手续，并提前打印您的登机牌。

defs.def: to live and take meals in sb's home, in return for payment 付费（在某人家里）膳宿
to live at a school during the school year （在学校）寄宿
